name: Six-stage loop vs spoken first audio (operator voice dead air)

A_real_six_stage_loop.statement: Every operator request must run a real PERCEIVE → RETRIEVE → PLAN → ACT → OBSERVE → LEARN loop. Skipping the brain for speed is forbidden.

B_spoken_progress.statement: Spoken operator turns must not go silent for seconds. Voice SLO P50 TTFA <500ms / P95 <800ms. If the loop takes ~5s, the operator should hear real, honest, incremental speech during that wait.
B_spoken_progress.today: OPTION 1 MET — incremental honest speech during the loop. Voice SLO P50<500 still NOT MET (TTFA 878ms on the closeout turn).

progressive_narration.what_it_is: Tool-execution narration plus Cognitive Loop stage speech (PERCEIVE/RETRIEVE/PLAN/ACT/OBSERVE) emitted as composed text-delta from live loop transitions. LEARN is not spoken. Fast-path stays silent. Never fabricated filler.
progressive_narration.http_talk: TTS is driven by text-delta. Loop-stage drafts now yield text-delta, so HTTP Talk speaks them.
progressive_narration.operator_shaped_plan_turns: Speak ACT as not-executing and OBSERVE as plan-check even when there is no tool SSE.

option1_closeout_2026_09_11.note: Plan-without-execute operator spoken turn. No tool SSE. Five loop-stage sentences then the plan.

close_only_after_named_choice: Speak honest loop-stage progress on the spoken path, derived from real loop state (not fabricated filler).
Make the six-stage loop fast enough that silence stays under the voice SLO.
Accept dead air as the explicit cost of a real loop (written product decision).
